requestMetadata: Exact procedure/fixed route classes,method,node timestamps only; no headers,bodies,query,origins
apiTrace: snapshots/screenshots/sources false; reject nonempty trace.network; strict metadata projection from ephemeral ZIP, removed after parse
supervisorQualification: Reuses approved supervisor; scans /proc and writes ownership every100ms, extra diagnostic-only host load, never acceptance timing
clockBrackets: Node before/after browser action anchor and observation finish; raw browser timeOrigin and API trace clock anchor preserved
currentActionChecks: Exactly one trusted pointerdown/click and one app measure starting after action anchor; preparation marks separately labelled
httpChecks: Status and original f9 error-code body detector; bounded reads, no bodies saved; cancelled/unavailable inspections explicit
failurePolicy: Best-effort projected partial phases on failure; raw ZIP removed in catch; finalizer removes residual named ZIP after process absence or fails without archiving raw ZIP
